title: SUMMERSLAM 2026 — 3 CALLS
narration: Thirteen days to SummerSlam. Our record calling this stuff early: thirty-one and nine. Three calls tonight — the last one ends a legend. First, we grade ourselves. June thirtieth, we called Sami Zayn holding the title all summer. Punk took it July sixth. Stamp it: miss. But that miss flips call one. Champions who win a belt within thirty days of a stadium show lose it there — seven of nine times. So: Cody Rhodes, new champion. Seventy-two percent. Call two. Reigns Rollins, match five of the stadium series. Rubber match booking favors Rollins. Sixty-one. Call three: Oba Femi pins Brock Lesnar inside the Cell. Twenty-eight percent. We're taking it anyway. Clip this. August second, every card gets graded — live.
